stages.name: Docker infrastructure setup
stages.description: Deploys Hadoop NameNode, DataNodes, Spark Master, Workers and History Server in a bridged network.

stages.name: HDFS cluster trace ingestion
stages.description: Ingests raw Google Cluster Trace 2019 and Alibaba Cluster Trace 2018 datasets into distributed storage.

stages.name: Schema standardisation MapReduce
stages.description: Unifies disparate column schemas, timestamp units and resource normalisation across both cloud providers.

stages.name: Synthetic syslog generation and regex extraction
stages.description: Generates unstructured cluster log messages and extracts error counts using regular expressions.

stages.name: Gradient Boosted Tree predictive models
stages.description: Trains GBT regressors and random forest hurdle classifiers for CPU, memory and task arrival rate forecasting.

stages.name: Recommendation engine
stages.description: Translates workload forecasts into automated proactive actions such as scale up, scale down or hold.

stages.name: Static reporting dashboard
stages.description: Renders proactive resource forecasts, cross cloud comparison metrics and recommendations in a static interface.

stages.name: Kubernetes production deployment
stages.description: Optional container orchestration deployment for real time cluster autoscaling controllers.
